hyperedges.label: Egress abuse defense (rules, counter, suspend, kill)

nodes.label: example-buyer/README (duplicate of root)
nodes.rationale: Byte-for-byte copy of the root README left over from an earlier build attempt; adds no new content and is a candidate for deletion.

nodes.label: example-buyer/docker-compose (duplicate of root)
nodes.rationale: Copy of the root docker-compose.yml (same backend/contributor/buyer services); the real compose file lives at the repo root.

nodes.label: Tiered isolation (container/gVisor/microVM)
nodes.rationale: Isolation is a pluggable, advertised, buyer-selectable property of a node. A node reports the strongest tier it can deliver (probe at startup); a buyer sets minIsolation; the registry never places below it and a contributor never silently downgrades.

nodes.label: Pluggable SandboxBackend
nodes.rationale: The daemon talks to a sandbox only through SandboxBackend (probe/create/destroy/list), so docker, gvisor, kata-fc and firecracker are drop-in backends selected by SANDBOX_BACKEND.

nodes.label: Never advertise a tier you can't deliver
nodes.rationale: If the configured backend is unavailable at startup the daemon refuses to register rather than falling back to a weaker tier — a node's advertised tier is always one it can actually provide.
nodes.norm_label: never advertise a tier you can't deliver

nodes.label: Key-only SSH by default
nodes.rationale: The buyer supplies a public key (web pastes; agent generates ed25519); the sandbox runs PasswordAuthentication no. The guessable wallet-address password returns only behind ALLOW_PASSWORD_SSH=true.

nodes.label: Per-lease egress firewall
nodes.rationale: EGRESS_MODE (allowlist default) applies a per-lease nftables ruleset: default-drop, DNS to the resolver only, buyer allowlist, drop cloud metadata + RFC1918. Blocks the mine/scan/spam/DDoS abuse that isolation alone does nothing about.

nodes.label: Egress-abuse suspension + kill switch
nodes.rationale: The daemon reports per-lease drop counters on heartbeat; a buyer past EGRESS_DROP_LIMIT is suspended and torn down. A local kill switch destroys every sandbox + its rules at once.

nodes.label: Teardown guarantee (guest TTL + reaper)
nodes.rationale: Leases live in memory, so a VM could outlive the registry and burn a contributor's machine. The guest self-powers-off at a hard TTL and a host reaper reconciles live sandboxes against known leases every REAP_INTERVAL_MS.

nodes.label: Docker socket mount = host root
nodes.rationale: Mounting /var/run/docker.sock into the daemon container gives it host root — the Docker API is unnamespaced, so a compromise starts a container that mounts / as root. The largest hole; it survives every other change.

nodes.label: Native systemd daemon (hardened)
nodes.rationale: Recommended: run the daemon as a host process under systemd (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateTmp, ReadWritePaths) instead of a socket-mounted container. Removes the socket-in-a-container hole; docker-group still equals root, which the microvm tier is what actually contains.

nodes.label: Fixed-schema host helper (option 2)
nodes.rationale: If the daemon must stay containerized, replace the socket with a tiny host helper accepting only create/destroy/list over a unix socket with a fixed argument schema, so the daemon can't ask the host for arbitrary Docker actions.

nodes.label: microVM tier needs /dev/kvm
nodes.rationale: The microvm tier needs /dev/kvm — bare metal or a nested-virt-capable instance. Standard DigitalOcean droplets do not expose it (registry + MongoDB can still live on DO). Absent KVM, kata-fc/firecracker fail startup by design; fall back to gvisor.

nodes.label: Ephemeral rootfs, no shared writable mounts
nodes.rationale: Each lease gets a guest kernel, cgroup v2 limits on the VMM, and an ephemeral read-only rootfs with noexec/nosuid tmpfs scratch — never a shared writable mount.
nodes.norm_label: ephemeral rootfs, no shared writable mounts

nodes.label: Auto-release images to GHCR
nodes.rationale: Matrix builds + pushes raven-backend and raven-contributor to GHCR on push to main and vX.Y.Z tags, using the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN (no secrets). web (static) and buyer (demo) are excluded.

nodes.label: web served static behind nginx
nodes.rationale: The web service builds the Next.js static export (NEXT_PUBLIC_* + MAINNET as build args) and serves out/ behind nginx on :3000.
